_doc: Tirupathur district's tannery common effluent treatment plants (CETPs), as listed by TNPCB (2020) and by the state's June 2026 progress report to NMCG: three, all in operation. Both lists place all three in 'Tirupattoor District' (TNPCB's row 7 prints 'Tirupattoor Dstrict'). TNPCB's 2020 list and the June 2026 report also list M/s TALCO Pernambut Tannery Effluent Treatment Company (Pernambut, Vellore District), which is in Vellore district and is left out.

Rows are transcribed from the PDFs and each row is checked by script (scripts/verify.py) against the page's text layer, as table cells on one line; the tables were also read from the rendered page images (img/tannery2020-1.png, img/mpr2606-54-54.png, img/mpr2606-55-55.png).
registerUnitId joins each plant to the TNGIS industry register's unit (treatment-plants.geojson, kind cetp, 2 units). The joins are by name and are the part to review: see joinBasis.

consentedKld is TNPCB's 2020 column 'CETP Consented Quantity (KLD)'; consentIssuedOn is the column 'CTO issued on' and renewalValidTo the column 'RCO validity'; permittedPercent and permittedKld are the columns '% Permitted quantity (in KLD)' and 'Permitted quantity (in KLD)'. The June 2026 report's renewal column is printed as a sentence; mpr2026.renewalStatus gives its date in the form the engine's status line expects, and renewalStatusAsPrinted the sentence.
notOnRegister: the Ambur plant's Maligaithope sector, which has no register unit. No official source read prints its location, so it is not drawn.

History, not plants: the 1996 Supreme Court judgment lists two 'TALCO Vaniyambadi Tanners Enviro Control Systems Ltd.' CETPs, at Vaniyambattu and at Udayendiram, Vaniyambadi (p.7); neither name is on TNPCB's 2020 list or the June 2026 report.
